facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 59°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations between 15 days earlier and 1 day later this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: left May 7; earlier seasons: May 21 (2023), May 24 (2024), May 22 (2025)

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: May 13 (2023), May 8 (2024), May 7 (2025)

evidence.name: Lyman Lake
evidence.detail: left June 13; earlier seasons: June 11 (2023), June 25 (2024), June 12 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the second highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Lyman Lake (5,990 ft) and the lowest at Stevens Pass (3,940 ft) and Trinity (2,890 ft).

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: 23.6 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 40.0 in (2023), 30.2 in (2024), 32.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: 20.1 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 26.9 in (2023), 21.3 in (2024), 26.3 in (2025)

evidence.name: Lyman Lake
evidence.detail: 48.8 in on April 4; earlier seasons: 52.8 in (2023), 37.7 in (2024), 42.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 28 and June 25, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 7, 1,088 ft below the pass; points to April 26 to June 25

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: melted out May 1, 2,138 ft below the pass; points to May 1 to July 15

evidence.name: Lyman Lake
evidence.detail: melted out June 13, 962 ft above the pass; points to April 28 to June 25
